path.emptyText: This base has no order yet: everything is asked at once. The order comes from “First you need to know” references — an orbital requires the electron and the atom, so questions about the orbital come once you know the atom.
path.emptyKind: In a kind (Schemes → Entry kinds) a reference field with the setting “Learning order: first you need to know what it points to” (e.g. “Requires”). A ready kind “Concept” with such a field: <c>templates/cogita/podstawy.json</c>.
path.emptyQuestion: A question has the field “First you need to know” itself, and through “About” it waits for what has to be known before what it asks about.
path.intro: From basics to details: a card comes when you know what has to be known before it. {levels}, {entries} in order.
path.circles: A circle in the order — these dependencies do not work:

outside.one: {count} entry with cards has no place in the order — it comes together with level 1.
outside.other: {count} entries with cards have no place in the order — they come together with level 1.

path.circleEnd: — this dependency does not work while the circle lasts.

flow.guess: Before you read — what do you think?
flow.locked: This story is still closed. It opens once you know what has to be known before it — from the basics:

weak.one: You already know everything this story requires — but {count} card of it is worth reviewing first.
weak.other: You already know everything this story requires — but {count} cards of it are worth reviewing first.

flow.mergedNext: Done: {merged} — choose the next one (all of them, in any order):

explore.legend: Bright — you know it; pale — fading; dashed outline — a border you can cross; fog — not discovered yet.

geo.pick: Map — tap to mark a place

pending.openNone: Every question is answered by some statement.
pending.thesisNone: Every statement (content in blocks) starts with a short sentence — the thesis.
pending.noSentence: does not start with a sentence
pending.tooLong: the first sentence has more than {n} characters
pending.circlesText: An entry requires something that (through other entries) requires the entry itself. Such a dependency does not work — fix “First you need to know” in one of them.
pending.stale: To check — something a statement points to has changed ({n})
pending.flagsKey: Reports are read by whoever holds the intake key of the knowledge base's area (Settings → intake).
pending.question: Question:
pending.parallelText: One pattern for every entry of a kind — mark which questions should be created. Each becomes a statement with the question as its thesis (open until something answers it).
pending.needKind: First add a kind with a field “Content in blocks” (e.g. import templates/cogita/komentarz.json).
